summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new Brand Group feature. 14/14 pytest cases pass (CRUD, non-admin 403, child SKU creation with brand_group_id, list account_ids expansion, delete-in-use guard, dashboard shared:true tiles for both member accounts, summary.stock_crates counted ONCE across shared tiles (+10 not +20), stock-transfer batches-available scoped correctly — included for member, excluded for non-member). Frontend verified: Brand Groups button + dialog on SKU Management (edit form shows member accounts), 600 ml Silver child list shows violet group badge 'QA Franchise Group · 3' with correct title tooltip, Add Child SKU form exposes 'Branding for' select with both options; choosing 'Brand group' shows the Brand Group select ('QA Franchise Group · 3 accounts') AND hides the Customer Account picker; choosing 'One customer account' shows the picker again. Customer Stock Dashboard renders violet 'shared' tags on member tiles (Bangalore Tech Park, Seed B) for the shared child SKU.
critical_code_review_comments: brand_groups.child_account_ids_map + account_child_filter cleanly encapsulate the owner-∪-group-members logic; no obvious concerns.
brand_groups.delete uses child_skus.count_documents without is_active filter — deactivated child SKUs also block deletion. Consider filtering by is_active if that's undesired (low priority).
